text.title: 柜台墙上的两周记录
text.situation:
五月下旬，附近学校为夏季集市订购包。订单激增，杰伊在墙上日历旁加了一张纸。不过市场周末之后，首饰销量下降了。米娜没有假设两条走势会一直朝同一方向变化。学校订单可以提高一周的卖包销量，却不一定改变整个夏季。订单开始稳定后，杰伊把做好的学校用包从柜台搬进库房，那里的闲置空间开始减少。加快裁剪可能加快生产，但每个提手仍要检查。关门时，努尔退后看日历。两个忙碌的星期足以改变计划，却不足以说明小店的一切。

订单记录——五月十九日至三十日
学校用包：学校询价后突然增加。
首饰：销量少于市场周末。
维修要求：第二周变化不大。
下周：接受下一笔大订单前，再看这些记录。

paragraphs.en: In late May, a nearby school asked for bags for its summer fair. There was a surge in orders, and Jay added a second sheet to the wall calendar. Sales of jewellery, however, showed a decline after the market weekend. Mina did not assume both lines would keep moving in the same direction. The school order could boost bag sales for one week without changing the rest of the summer. When orders began to stabilise, Jay moved the finished school bags off the counter and into the stockroom. The unused space there began to shrink. Faster cutting might accelerate production, but they still checked every handle. At closing time, Noor stood back from the calendar. Two busy weeks were enough to change their plans, but not enough to tell them everything about the shop.

paragraphs.en:
ORDER NOTES — 19–30 MAY
School bags: sudden rise after the school enquiry.
Jewellery: fewer sales than at the market weekend.
Repair requests: little change in the second week.
Next week: review these notes before accepting another large order.

S08.Q12.P01.function: Two weeks on the counter wall
S08.Q12.P01.cue: 说说订单和首饰销量的变化。
acceptableAnswers: 学校订单突然大幅增加。 周末后首饰销量下降。

S08.Q12.P02.function: Two weeks on the counter wall
S08.Q12.P02.cue: 说说后来订单和储存怎样变化。
acceptableAnswers: 忙碌一周后，订单开始稳定。 库房闲置空间开始减少。

S08.Q12.P03.function: Two weeks on the counter wall
S08.Q12.P03.cue: 说明什么可能提高销量、加快生产。
acceptableAnswers: 更快裁剪可能加快生产。 学校订单可能提高卖包销量。
